description: I’ve begun participating in hackathons this year and truly enjoy the process of focusing intensely on solving a specific problem within a span of a few hours. Winning isn’t important; what matters most is the learning I gain from the challenges themselves and from the people I meet. I am a researcher on GenAI, but at these hackathons, I’ve encountered many self-taught experts with a profound mastery of AI agents. When joining a team, reaching a consensus is difficult, so I’ve decided to go solo.
